environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed on EKS 1.28 with Pod Security Standards enforced at namespace level via 'restricted' profile label (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). Container securityContext specifies drop: [ALL] with explicit add for only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. Additionally, the node pool runs with a custom seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) applied via annotation, and the container filesystem is set to readOnlyRootFilesystem: true with specific tmpfs mounts for /tmp only. The cluster uses Cilium CNI with a CiliumNetworkPolicy restricting egress to only the application database on port 5432 and DNS on port 53.

config.ingress: istio-ingressgateway with AuthorizationPolicy requiring valid JWT
